name: lanes
description: See every teammate's coding agents and the files they hold. Coordinates agents so they never collide, without ever blocking an edit.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Lanes runs git and a local coordination server in your repository, so it needs a trusted folder.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Lanes
walkthroughs.description: Three steps from install to your first agent in the Agents view, and team context when you want it.

steps.title: Working alone? Nothing to start
steps.description:
Working alone, Lanes starts by itself with your first Claude Code session, so you can go straight to the next step. For a team, one person starts the team server and sends everyone the join message (see the notes on the right).
[Start Local Server](command:lanes.startServer)
[Copy Team Server Command](command:lanes.copyServerCommand)
[Join Team Server](command:lanes.joinTeam)

steps.title: Set up this repository
steps.description:
Adds the Lanes hook to the open repository and commits it. Push the commit so teammates get it.
[Set Up Repository](command:lanes.setupRepository)

steps.title: Run a Claude Code session
steps.description:
Start Claude Code in the repository. Its agent appears in the Lanes view, and the files it edits get a badge in the Explorer. Lanes never blocks an edit.
[Open the Agents View](command:lanes.agents.focus)

steps.title: Optional: share team context with agents
steps.description:
Off until you turn it on. Agents in the repository then get a short team brief with each prompt and a heads-up before they touch a file a teammate is changing. Commit .lanes/team.json so teammates get it. The Team view and the browser app hold the team chat and requests.
[Turn On Team Context](command:lanes.teamContextOn)
[Open Team App](command:lanes.openApp)

colors.description: Explorer badge and lock colour for a file a teammate's agent holds.
Explorer badge and lock colour for a file your own agent holds.

lanes.serverUrl.description: Address of the Lanes server, for example http://192.168.1.20:4317. Left at the default, Lanes uses the server that lanes join or lanes login saved. Also saved to ~/.lanes/config.json so the agent hooks use it. A machine setting: a repository's .vscode/settings.json cannot point Lanes at another server.

lanes.token.description: Token for the Lanes server: the team token, or your personal token. Leave empty to use the personal token that lanes join or lanes login saved, or, for a server on this machine, its own token. Also saved to ~/.lanes/config.json so the agent hooks use it. A machine setting: it is not synced by Settings Sync and a repository cannot set it.

lanes.userName.description: Your name as teammates see it. Empty uses the name lanes join or lanes login saved, then git config user.name.
